scope: Proposition 7.2 (Compilation of slots) of the manuscript “Polynomial-Time Unitary Synthesis from a Boolean Oracle” (preprints/Polynomial-Time-Unitary-Synthesis-from-a-Boolean-Oracle-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 283 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 198849e472386b7a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let a skeleton have S slots on Q qubits, and put η = 1/h for an integer h ≥ 2. There is a deterministic procedure, polynomial in Q, S, 1/η, that produces a circuit over H, T, T†, CNOT and one Boolean oracle, with polynomially many qubits, gates, calls, and address bits. For every assignment of the slot tables, some contents of that oracle make the circuit differ from the prescribed skeleton by at most Sη on inputs with its added scratch qubits zero, with the comparison circuit keeping those scratch qubits zero.
